name: Button
description: Triggers an action or event, such as submitting a form or opening a dialog.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual emphasis. Use one primary button per view.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a spinner, disables the button and sets aria-busy.

props.name: icon
props.description: Optional leading icon. Hidden from assistive tech; the label carries meaning.

props.name: ...props
props.description: All native button attributes, including disabled, type and onClick.

a11y: Renders a native <button>; defaults to type="button" so it never submits a form by accident.
Keyboard focus shows a visible outline with at least 3:1 contrast against the stage.
While loading the label stays in the DOM and aria-busy="true" is set.
Label text meets WCAG AA contrast (4.5:1) against its face color in light and dark themes.
